raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validator output, the issue is that the `edge` syntax is missing the directional operator. According to the error message, edges need an operator like `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`. For a flowchart, `->` is the appropriate directional operator, and labels in the middle use the syntax `-[label]->`.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 flowchart
title "BGP session reset procedure"

process checkcounters "Check interface error counters"
decision errorsfound "Errors found?"
process clearcounters "Clear counters"
terminator monitor "Monitor session"
terminator escalate "Escalate to operator"

edge checkcounters -> errorsfound
edge errorsfound -[yes]-> clearcounters
edge errorsfound -[no]-> escalate
edge clearcounters -> monitor
```

The key changes:
- Line 11: `edge checkcounters -> errorsfound` (added `->` operator)
- Line 12: `edge errorsfound -[yes]-> clearcounters` (added `->` operator and moved label into the middle with `-[yes]->` syntax)
- Line 13: `edge errorsfound -[no]-> escalate` (added `->` operator and moved label into the middle with `-[no]->` syntax)
- Line 14: `edge clearcounters -> monitor` (added `->` operator)

This fixes all four syntax errors by providing the required directional operators and using the correct label placement syntax for mid-edge labels.
